results.content: Revix AI is a cloud-based AI code review service for software engineering teams. It connects to GitHub, GitLab.com, or Bitbucket Cloud repositories and analyzes existing code to derive editable review rules based on a team's conventions. Teams can review and adjust extracted rules, select repositories, and use Revix alongside their existing source-control workflow without adding a CI job.
